results.definition: THIS DEVICE IS INDICATED FOR THE FIXATION OF PATHOLOGICAL FRACTURES OF THE VERTEBRAL BODY USING VERTEBROPLASTY OR KYPHOPLASTY PROCEDURES.   THE DEVICE RESORBS (TIME FRAME MAY BE INDICATED) AND IS REPLACED WITH BONE DURING THE HEALING PROCESS.
